channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: At least 15 newborns killed in Pakistan hospital fire
item.description: Only one child rescued after fire breaks out in the nursery at Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, Geo News reports.

item.title: Dozens killed in rebel attacks on Sudan’s Kordofan, medical group says
item.description: Sudan Doctors Network says SPLM-N rebels killed 27 people in South Kordofan, including four children.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran says Hormuz remains closed despite Oman route deal
item.description: Tehran says the agreement with Oman on routes through Hormuz does not indicate that the strait is open.

item.title: Seven killed in Gaza as Israeli strike ‘destroys’ aid supply warehouse
item.description: Health Ministry warns of 'complete collapse of the basic necessities of life' in Gaza as Israel's attacks continue.

item.title: New US sanctions signal Trump desperation on Iran, experts say
item.description: Economic escalation is unlikely to force the Iranian government to capitulate to US demands, according to experts.

item.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
item.description: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.

item.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
item.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.
